title: Image Widget
description: An image that fills its width, in a figure with an optional caption. `ratio` and `fit` give it a box of fixed proportions.

srcProp.description: The image's URL. It interpolates `{{ }}` like any top-level string, so restrict where images may come from with the host page's Content Security Policy (`img-src`).

altProp.description: What the image shows, for screen readers and when it fails to load. `""` marks a decorative image, which screen readers skip.

ratioProp.description: The proportions of the image's box, width to height. Without it the image keeps its own.

fitProp.description: How the image fills a box of another shape, as CSS `object-fit`. Defaults to `cover`.

captionProp.description: A caption shown below the image.

loadingProp.description: When the browser loads it: `lazy` (the default) waits until it is near the screen; `eager` suits an image at the top of the page.
